depth_model: Per-frame continuous parallax ratio; height/camera_height = 1 - 1/ratio. These are relative estimates, not physical heights or connectivity labels.
display_evidence: All-frame reprojection. Blue: probability > 0.85 and at least 3 source frames; gray: probability > 0.5 and at least 3 frames. Raw evidence is retained in NPZ.
frame_to_map: (vertical + (project(projection, roi) - vertical) / ratio + camera[frame]) @ rotation.T - origin
limitations: Local scale interpolation requires observed road support.
Camera calibration assumes square grid and ROI-centered principal point.
Projected road crossings do not establish connectivity.
No independent global geometry or field-click validation.
Existing camera and source-plane estimates define fixed map coordinates.
Two other views check raw roads, not independent global geometry.
Only accepted source domains are redrawn. Remaining pixels retain the parent map.
The parent surface_data is unchanged; redraw_data describes the displayed view.
No gameplay navigation or Wiki localization acceptance.
